alternatives.name: FUND_ETF_CROSS_ASSET_WHALE_EVENT_WITH_FLOW_PROXY
tradeoffs: ETF flow proxies and cross-asset regime snapshots are synthetic bounded signals; they do not substitute for 13F regulatory_disclosure rows.

negative: Flow proxies remain indirect; correlation/regime context must not be treated as causal attribution.
positive: fund_etf_cross_asset family completes the eight-family whale vocabulary with bounded fixture entitlement on NVDA.

decision.summary: Fund/ETF cross-asset whale events use whale_event payloads with family fund_etf_cross_asset, event_subtype (etf_flow_proxy|cross_asset_regime), flow_ratio (DERIVED), correlation_to_benchmark (DERIVED), regime_label, direction_label (supports_long|supports_short|neutral), and source fixture_synthetic. PIT queries exclude events whose available_time exceeds prediction_cutoff. 13F holdings remain under regulatory_disclosure.
decision.title: Fund/ETF cross-asset whale envelope semantics

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance authorizes fixture-first fund_etf_cross_asset on ADMITTED-ETF-CROSSASSET-NVDA-001 only. Live ETF flow APIs require separate entitlement records.
